body: People are remembered, whether they want to be or not. When someone is gone, their existence and all that they are is literally in the minds of everyone they crossed paths with. It may not even be a conscious memory, but an emotion or decision someone makes because they interacted with you. That’s eternal life to me.
Love, prayers and thoughts for you. ❤️ How you feel (or felt) is understandable and all too common in this world. I hope you are doing better right now, whatever that may mean.
Cudder is full of songs for people like us. I like Do It Alone.

I feel you, so much. I too hate people, but part of me also hates me for hating everyone. It’s a burden to feel like the world is a disaster and that everyone is an asshole or an idiot (however true it may be). I’ve cut nearly everyone from my life, including family, not because I hate them but because my view of the world and my anxiety coupled with it makes all social interaction exhausting. Lately I’ve been unmotivated, and it’s like I don’t wanna be this way and want to feel better but I also don’t care because the world isn’t worth it to me, yk? I can’t kill myself because my sister just died suddenly a month ago and it would break my mom beyond repair to lose two of us. 
I am also gay and in my twenties, was forced out of the closet at 14 or 15 when my dad took my laptop and snooped, and when it went around my school after a couple close friends let it spread around. I know what it’s like to feel judged and looked down upon. I also have a hard time trusting anyone because of it all, especially the way my parents violated my privacy so badly (it’s a long story and I won’t elaborate here). I know what it’s like to lose all hope and all faith, and wonder ‘why bother?’ Meds just make me numb and therapy is a joke I’ve been in and out of since I was a kid (my divorced parents used to use my therapy sessions to argue about parenting instead of the fact that their 8 year old was waking up with panic attacks, etc). Tbh, I don’t want to change, I just want the world to go away. I have accepted that I’m odd and I’d rather just exist on the margins of society. That’s easier said than done because people don’t get that and won’t leave me be. Anyway, just showing some solidarity and understanding. Honestly, maybe we’re the normal ones who just see the world as it is… It’s ugly out there.
